results.title: Spanish transport minister says to step down after two serious high-speed train tragedies this year - Chinadaily.com.cn
results.snippet:
The Toledo crash came just over nine months after a railway accident in Adamuz in southern Spain which killed 46 people in January. The two disasters along the same high-speed corridor have intensified scrutiny of Spain's railway safety and management.
